page.layout: One printed page of text in a single column, in italic type. Running head "Præfatio." centred at the top. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right. The strip at the right edge belongs to the facing page and is not transcribed.

p.i: do, calumniando in odium orthodoxarum ecclesiarum inflammant, & ad propugnāda armis ferrog; pōt ficis[?] Romani auctoritate vel potius tyrannide incitāt. Et ut illud quod volunt facilius ac facilius obtineant, prædicant superiorum seculorū tranquillitatem, concordiam & fœlicissimum statum, quibus videlicet in toto orbe regnavit sedes Romana; & contra conquer[illegible, ~1 letter] de nostri temporis infelicitate, bellis, turbis, odiis, insidiis, condemnationibus, proscriptionibus, cædibus, & undique circumstantibus rerum et vitæ periculis, omniumq; illorum malorum culpam imputant ecclesiarum reformationi.

Offenduntur multi: infirmiores admodum turbantur: quamplurimi fluctuantur animis: quidam ad tumidam Iesuitarum maledicentiam taceri volunt: nonnulli autem partim ob publici status ruinam, partim ob suarum opum et commodorum jacturam fremunt: alii nondum satis de doctrinā confirmati admirantur et cogitant, quam ob causam ecclesiarum reformationem tanta consequatur malorum moles, omniaq; ruant in deterius, quā reli-

page.notes: The "conquer" line has an ink blotch over part of the word, so the word after it is unreadable. "ferrog;" and "ficis" are doubtful readings. The catchword "gionis" sits below the last line, and the text ends on the hyphenated "reli-". No page number is printed.
